description: Always order movement records by the physical timestamp 变盘时间 ascending. The earliest record is the opening snapshot and the latest record before kickoff is the latest snapshot. Never infer order from row position or from the word 初/即.
scope: All 欧指变盘, 亚盘变盘, and 大小球变盘 reads.

description: The analytical database exposes exactly seven final SQLite tables and zero views. Do not use staging tables, raw JSON, Markdown match files, or a second database as analysis input.
scope: All football match reads in this workspace.

description: Never fill a missing odd, line, timestamp, team, or status by estimation or fabrication. Missing data stays an explicit gap; a market absent from the seven tables is not offered.
scope: All seven tables and all downstream reads.

description: 球队基本情况 has exactly 14 columns and only three data types: 比赛信息 (one row per match), 阵容 (player lineup rows), and 伤停 (injury rows). A different shape means schema drift and must be treated as a data-quality failure.
The 1X2 table uses the 21 fixed euro cids: 80, 545, 281, 90, 177, 432, 115, 82, 81, 104, 255, 110, 2, 474, 649, 800, 482, 386, 826, 16, 1129. Match on cid, not on display name alone.
scope: 欧指 and 欧指变盘 bookmaker identity.
